C1470.title: NHTSA Opens Safety Probe into Tesla Autopilot After 11 Crashes with Parked Emergency Vehicles Result in One Fatality
C1470.summary: In August 2021, the U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) launched a safety investigation into Tesla's Autopilot driver-assistance system covering 765,000 Model Y, X, S, and 3 vehicles from model years 2014–2021. The probe was triggered by 11 incidents in which Teslas with Autopilot engaged struck stationary emergency vehicles displaying warning lights, including seven police

references.title: Tesla Under Safety Investigation: 7 Police Cars Hit in 11 Incidents, 3 Drivers Under Influence, 1 Death
